decision_conditions: <p>The proposed use of the roof terrace shall only be operated between 12.00 hours and 22.00 hours daily.</p><p>REASON: To protect residential amenity of surrounding occupiers.</p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p>The sound limiting device shall be set up to limit any amplified music (live or recorded) not to exceed the prevailing ambient background noise at any time and an acoustic report by a qualified Acoustic Consultant, who is a member of the Institute of Acoustics (loA) or other similar professional body, shall be submitted to the Local Authority for approval. All the recommendations within the report must be implemented prior to the regulated entertainment taking place.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that future occupiers do not suffer a loss of amenity by reason of noise nuisance and other excess noise from activities within the premises.</p>

<p>Details, including samples, of the balustrading, canopies and all materials to be used on the external surfaces of the structures shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority, in writing, before work on the balustrading, canopies and approved structures commences on site. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.</p>

<p>Any amplified music (live or recorded) to be played on the roof terrace at any time shall not exceed the prevailing ambient background noise level at any time.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that future occupiers do not suffer a loss of amenity by reason of noise nuisance and other excess noise from activities within the premises.</p>

<p>Any amplified music (live or recorded) to be played on the roof terrace at any time shall be rooted via a sound limiting device.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that future occupiers do not suffer a loss of amenity by reason of noise nuisance and other excess noise from activities within the premises.</p>
